login.title: Connect GD Music Studio Playlists
login.note: Enter a public NetEase user UID to sync playlists, or leave blank to continue with imported playlists and built-in charts.

failure.rateLimited: GD Music Studio API rate limit reached. Please try again in a few minutes.
failure.unsupportedSource: GD Music Studio API does not currently support upstream "{{upstream}}". Switch to netease or another supported source in mod settings.
failure.noAudio: GD Music Studio returned no playable audio URL for this track.
failure.cloudflare: GD Music Studio returned a non-JSON challenge page. Please check your network or try again later.
failure.playlistNotFound: Could not load this playlist. Make sure the ID is valid and the playlist is public.

switch.done: Switched GD Music Studio search upstream to: {{upstream}}

import.playlistDone: Imported playlist "{{name}}" ({{count}} tracks). View it in Playlists or Explore (click Sync/Refresh if already open).
import.userDone: Synced {{count}} public playlists for UID {{uid}}. View them in Playlists or Explore (click Sync/Refresh if already open).
import.jsonDone: Imported {{playlists}} playlist(s) ({{tracks}} tracks) from JSON. View them in Playlists or Explore.
import.jsonEmpty: No valid GD Music Studio playlist or track entries were found in that JSON file.
